item.title: Virginia woman allegedly shot by officer in domestic incident sues police chief, town for $143.7M
item.description: A woman who says she was shot multiple times by a Kenbridge police officer is now suing the town and its police chief, claiming the chief ignored her pleas for help moments before she was shot.

item.title: Virginia cruises to 90-61 win over NC State
item.description: Thijs De Ridder scored 19 points lead five Virginia players in double figures as the 11th-ranked Cavaliers beat North Carolina State 90-61 on Tuesday night.
